dispositions.finding: Durable spec labels were unsalted credential-derived verifiers.
dispositions.repair: SpecDigest now canonicalizes every credential environment value to a constant marker. Actual values are compared only in memory and final credentials are rotated; pre-review credential-derived values were retracted from evidence.

dispositions.finding: The PostgreSQL rotation runbook stopped with the already-invalid old administrator credential.
dispositions.repair: The verified next value is promoted before stop and is unset only after OFF; the runbook states the old value intentionally fails closed.

dispositions.finding: Structurally complete evidence could pass while heads, roles, reviews, recovery, and artifacts were semantically incoherent.
dispositions.repair: Added a release semantic validator and CLI binding every final head, image/topology role, review actor/head/verdict, ordered recovery lineage, exact mount set, and distinct required artifact kind. Complete adversarial fixtures cover every invariant; schema role/path/contains constraints were tightened.

dispositions.finding: One serial broker worker could miss the concurrent Issue/PR control deadline.
dispositions.repair: The runner now has exactly two typed broker workers with independent bounded reads and a dual-delayed-request concurrency regression.

dispositions.finding: MONITOR_ONLY unnecessarily received provider credentials, credential volume, and provider egress.
dispositions.repair: MONITOR_ONLY uses providerAuth=none, has no provider secret/volume/destination, and is covered by Go configuration/topology and TypeScript startup regressions.

dispositions.finding: ACTIVE readiness accepted malformed or unusable provider authentication.
dispositions.repair: Runner startup validates private Codex auth metadata and JSON structure; agentopsctl then performs a bounded nonlogging provider authentication probe and returns only constant failure text. Malformed-file and rejected-probe regressions were added.

dispositions.finding: Mutable Debian mirrors and globally installed provider CLIs left the OCI transitive graph nonreproducible.
dispositions.repair: All Debian installs use a dated snapshot and both exact provider CLI graphs are installed with npm ci from a committed integrity lock.

dispositions.finding: The production gh CLI broker read branch had no direct tests.
dispositions.repair: An injectable exec boundary now directly tests production multi-page parsing/cursor advance, credential-free argv, page and byte limits, and provider timeout.

dispositions.finding: Terminal broker request rows had no retention policy.
dispositions.repair: Request creation prunes terminal rows older than seven days while runtime_audit remains the durable audit record.

dispositions.finding: A control timeout could orphan a newly succeeded response and repeat a provider read.
dispositions.repair: Control reuses the most recent succeeded response for the exact Registration version, kind, and cursor digest before creating a request.

dispositions.finding: The stale-registration rejection query assumed a single broker worker.
dispositions.repair: The rejection path now selects candidates with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED before update, matching the two-worker claim concurrency.
